name: dsh-reel-studio
description: 插件宣传台 for DSH：输入插件名，在本机出 28 秒真机界面宣传片与封面。自带逐帧渲染器（本机 Chrome，运动模糊 + 硬切保护），npm 装完即可出片，不需要 Onetake 运行时。

scripts.check: npm run typecheck && node --check lib/index.js && node --check lib/server.js && node --check lib/plan.js && node --check lib/client.js && node --check scripts/reel.mjs && node --check scripts/film.mjs && node --check design/build.mjs && node --check tools/v01-film/make-v01-film.mjs && node --check tools/v01-film/render-frames.mjs
scripts.campaign:render: cd studio && node_modules/.bin/remotion render src/v2/entry.tsx ReelPromo out/reel-promo.mp4 --codec h264 --crf 16 --concurrency=1
scripts.campaign:still: cd studio && node_modules/.bin/remotion still src/v2/entry.tsx ReelPromo out/reel-frame.png --frame=300
scripts.campaign:render:case: cd studio && node_modules/.bin/remotion render src/v2/entry.tsx ReelCase out/case-better-sidebar.mp4 --codec h264 --crf 16 --concurrency=1
scripts.campaign:render:case30: cd studio && node_modules/.bin/remotion render src/v2/entry.tsx ReelCase30 out/case-better-sidebar-30s.mp4 --codec h264 --crf 16 --concurrency=1
scripts.home:render: cd studio && node_modules/.bin/remotion render src/sorenyeah/entry.tsx SorenyeahHome out/sorenyeah-home.mp4 --codec h264 --crf 16
scripts.home:poster: cd studio && node_modules/.bin/remotion still src/sorenyeah/entry.tsx SorenyeahPoster out/sorenyeah-poster.png --frame=0
